about_role.text: Senior Executive Assistant / Executive Business Partner supporting the Head of Brand & Customer. This is not a traditional calendar-and-inbox EA: the role expects broad ownership across project coordination, meeting preparation, marketing operations, systems and processes, travel, inbox and calendar management, communications and some personal administration. The scope is deliberately wide and responsibility grows with context and trust; the core objective is to expand the executive’s bandwidth by anticipating needs, solving problems independently and keeping priorities moving without constant oversight.

actual_duties.text: You will manage the executive’s inbox and calendar tightly (triage, draft responses, protect time, add prep/context to entries), plan and document domestic and international travel end‑to‑end, and handle personal logistics as required. You’ll coordinate projects and cross‑functional work to keep deadlines and deliverables on track, prepare meeting briefs and capture follow‑ups, and provide hands‑on support for marketing productions and supplier interactions. A major part of the role is building and improving systems: create templates, checklists, trackers and AI‑enabled workflows (using Notion or similar and AI tools) so recurring problems are solved rather than repeatedly managed. You’ll draft professional communications in the executive’s voice and proactively follow up on outstanding actions.

candidate.text: Required: 8+ years of broad, end‑to‑end business experience and a track record of owning outcomes rather than only completing tasks; demonstrated independent judgment and comfort making decisions; strong organisational skills, exceptional written English, attention to detail, commercial judgement, research and problem‑solving ability; high discretion with confidential information; proven experience building or improving processes and practical experience with AI tools and Notion (or similar). Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional track record is required. You must be able to work full‑time with strong daily overlap to New Zealand business hours. Preferred: experience in fast‑growth businesses, Founder’s Office/Chief‑of‑Staff style roles, senior EA/EBP experience, marketing/production coordination, and building AI‑enabled automations.

arrangements.text: Engagement is as a contractor/independent contractor. Compensation is listed as $1,500–$3,000 (also specified as USD 1,500–3,000 per month in the posting). Working hours are described as full‑time with New Zealand hours and the listing states the candidate must have strong daily overlap with New Zealand business hours. The posting includes a timezone restriction field (‘8’) but does not clarify how that maps to eligibility or hours; do not infer additional location or hour requirements from that single value. Seniority is listed as Senior. The listing was originally posted on Himalayas. If any of these points are critical to your application, treat contractor status and full‑time expectation as coexisting but confirm billing, benefits and legal status with the hirer before accepting.

about_role.text: This is a Senior Bookkeeper role at Chris Shaw Accounting Services, a small Australian‑owned chartered firm that provides tax, BAS, bookkeeping and advisory services. The position is senior level and listed as full‑time. The role expects the postholder to manage accurate financial records across multiple clients, produce periodic financial reports, and ensure bookkeeping work meets professional standards.

actual_duties.text: You will keep client ledgers and transaction records current, reconcile bank and credit card accounts, prepare monthly/quarterly/annual statements, handle accounts payable and receivable, oversee payroll processing, support tax return preparation and audits, maintain regulatory compliance, and train junior bookkeepers as the team grows.

candidate.text: Minimum requirement is 4 years of Australian bookkeeping experience in a public practice setting. The role requires Xero proficiency, solid knowledge of Australian bookkeeping principles, strong organization and time management, high accuracy and attention to detail, excellent written and verbal English, and the ability to work independently and in a team.

arrangements.text: Compensation is listed as PHP 100,000 per month (also shown as “100,000 pesos per month”), with a bonus structure. The job is offered as permanent work‑from‑home, full time, Monday–Friday 7:00 am to 3:00 pm Philippine time. New equipment will be supplied. The posting includes a timezone restriction value of “8.” Categories identify this as a remote/senior bookkeeping role. The listing does not state additional benefits beyond those listed.

about_role.text: This is a mid-level Graphic Designer / Video Editor role focused on creating visual content that supports marketing and student recruitment campaigns. The role is 100% remote but expressly tied to the Philippines: you may work remotely from anywhere in the Philippines. The posting lists Employment type as Full Time and categorizes the job under video and design functions. A nighttime schedule is specified (8:00 PM to 5:00 AM PH Time).

actual_duties.text: You will produce short- and long-form video content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts, promotional and campus videos), create thumbnails and visual assets, and optimize outputs for platforms and web. You will design social and digital assets (static posts, carousels, stories), prepare print-ready collateral (brochures, posters, signage) and manage file prep for printing. The role requires translating campaign objectives into visuals, supporting student-recruitment initiatives, collaborating with marketing, managing multiple projects to deadlines, incorporating feedback, maintaining organized working files, staying current on trends, and providing on-site filming support when needed.

candidate.text: Required: 2–3 years of graphic design and video editing experience; a strong portfolio showing digital design, social content, video editing, campaign assets and print materials; proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro and After Effects; knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube formats and engagement approaches; experience producing both short- and long-form video; ability to manage multiple projects, meet tight deadlines, and maintain brand consistency; basic print production/file-prep knowledge; good communication and collaboration skills. Preferred: experience in marketing, education, or student recruitment is noted as preferable.

arrangements.text: Compensation is not specified in the listing. Benefits and perks listed include HMO (up to 2 dependents), life insurance, 30 PTOs with leave conversion, parental and maternity benefits, and additional allowances (transportation, internet, clothing, laundry & rice). The role is fully remote within the Philippines and follows a Monday–Friday schedule 8:00 PM–5:00 AM (PH Time). The posting requires applicants to consent to personal data collection for recruitment and notes applications go through an ATS; processing times may vary. The listing also shows a numeric “Timezone restrictions: 8” entry; its meaning is unclear and the posting does not explain it.

about_role.text: TechnologyAdvice hires a Client Success Operations Coordinator to support client campaign delivery from a remote-first environment. This is an entry-level, full-time role based in the Philippines and expected to follow overnight hours: 9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT (Apr–Oct) or 10:00 PM–7:00 AM PHT (Nov–Mar). The position works with Client Success and internal operations to keep programs on track and resolve delivery issues.

actual_duties.text: You will set up and maintain programs in Salesforce (or similar CRM), monitor active campaigns, troubleshoot setup and delivery problems, prepare and validate regular campaign reports, coordinate internal handoffs, review leads against program requirements, keep documentation current, and recommend workflow improvements. The listed duties are general and may be adjusted as business needs change.

candidate.text: The role suits an organized, detail-oriented person who communicates clearly, adapts in fast-paced work, and manages multiple deadlines. Required skills include proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel, familiarity with Salesforce or the ability to learn CRMs, and being proactive about spotting and escalating issues. Applicants must have a working laptop/PC, reliable internet plus a backup connection. Pre-employment screening is required. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Philippines; the employer does not provide visa sponsorship. AI-generated or incomplete application answers will be automatically rejected.

arrangements.text: Compensation is listed as ₱37,500–₱46,000 per month. This is a full-time (40-hour) position with Flex Fridays and remote-first expectations, but the role is restricted to hires authorized to work in the Philippines. Benefits include 14 days paid time off plus government holidays (plus 5 additional days after one year), enrollment in SSS/PhilHealth/HDMF, corporate HMO after two months, a monthly de minimis (rice) allowance, Headspace access, and speaker-series bonuses. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company does not accept candidates through external staffing agencies, communicates only via @technologyadvice.com addresses and official platforms, and warns applicants against recruitment scams.
